purpose: Prevent double counting when the same external residents can be represented by both housing and workplace scenarios.
requiredChecks: 100 percent overlap never deducts more than the smaller positive external component
deduction is monotonic in overlap percentage
overlap never alters the demographic baseline when no housing/workplace scenario is active
FA scenario totals remain additive across municipalities
governance: The overlap percentage is an explicit scenario assumption, not an estimated baseline parameter.
Default 25 percent is a user-facing reference assumption and must remain editable.
Any empirical future overlap model should replace this control only after separate validation.
